zero_cost_disclosure.heading: ZERO-COST-DISCLOSURE
zero_cost_disclosure.implication: every figure in this document is gross and cost-free; no spread, commission, or swap enters any calculation. Realised results would differ (likely worse) under any real cost schedule.
zero_cost_disclosure.lifting: only an explicit operator directive may introduce a cost model for a scoped experiment; the directive is recorded in that experiment's design.md.
